name: Arusha
tagline: The gateway to a northern safari circuit
summary: Use Arusha to recover from travel and organize a northern Tanzania safari. Tarangire and Ngorongoro are major excursions with park, vehicle and guide costs, not quick city attractions. The city-day budget excludes safari packages.
seasonNote: Dry-season wildlife trips are popular; rain affects roads, and mountain conditions vary by altitude.
arrival: Kilimanjaro International (JRO) and Arusha Airport (ARK) are different airports; confirm your pickup location.
gettingAround: Use a reputable operator for parks and verified local transport for city stops. Safari distances require proper road-time allowances.
cashTip: Carry modest TZS cash for local spending and agreed tips; park packages may be quoted in USD. Confirm card surcharges and inclusions.
foodTip: Try local grilled dishes, ugali and Tanzanian coffee; check food-hygiene standards on excursions.
buyTip: Choose crafts from identifiable makers and obtain documentation for high-value purchases.
baseArea: Central Arusha or a lodge convenient for the next safari leg

connections.note: Allow roughly 6–8 hours or more including variable border processing; check visas and pickup details.
